The Independence Business Alliance provides connections, opportunities, and resources to LGBTQ+ businesses, professionals, and allies in the Greater Philadelphia tri-state area. In collaboration with our members and partners, we expand economic opportunities, advocate for diverse spaces, and promote inclusive leadership.

The Independence Business Alliance is a membership-based business advocacy organization dedicated to making the Philadelphia region an influential and diverse LGBTQ+ business community with an impact on economic development, equal rights and policy issues. The IBA is an official affiliate of the National LGBTQ+ & Allied Chamber of Commerce (NGLCC).

November ConnX: with Philly Pride Visitor Center

Join the IBA at our monthly networking event, ConnX! This ConnX will be in partnership with the Philly Pride Visitor Center, located in the heart of the Gayborhood, at 12th and Locust. Come walk through the new Pride Visitor Center, shop the locally made gifts, and stay to chat with our network at Knock Bar.

This event is FREE and open to all!

Meet local business owners, employees, and other community stakeholders. Whether you’ve been attending IBA events regularly, haven’t been in a while, or are brand new to the IBA, we’d love to have you join us.

Monday, November 16, 2026

360° Branding Workshop: From Strategy to Website to AI-Ready Marketing

Join the IBA and Pixel Parlor for a 360 degree branding workshop that every person who struggles with and could use support with branding, website, and marketing should attend!

Who it’s for:
-Anyone who feels like marketing is a hamster wheel
-Anyone whose brand, website, and marketing feel like three separate projects instead of one connected system
-Small business owners who handle their own marketing (or wish someone else did) — no design or marketing background needed

What you’ll learn:

-How business strategy, brand strategy, website design, and marketing actually connect — and why skipping a step shows up as problems later (a website that doesn’t convert, marketing that doesn’t land)
-The signs that a brand has outgrown itself, and how to spot them in your own business
-A real case study showing how one brand’s vision statement directly reshaped their website’s navigation — a concrete look at how strategy becomes structure
-How to turn your brand fundamentals into a brief that gets AI tools to write like you, instead of like everyone else

November 16, 2026
2:00 PM – 3:30 PM

Branding / Marketing Workshop

Join the IBA and Pixel Parlor for a 360 degree branding workshop that every person who struggles with and could use support with branding, website, and marketing should attend! 

What you’ll walk away with:

  • A first draft of the hardest, highest-value pieces of your own brand: your mission, your “onlyness statement” (what you do that nobody else does), and your top audience segments
  • A reusable AI brief template, built from your own answers, ready to paste into any AI writing tool
  • A clear-eyed read on where your website or marketing might be out of sync with your brand today

Who it’s for:

  • Anyone who feels like marketing is a hamster wheel
